newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki joins stocks correction, off over one pct.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki joins stocks correction, off over one pct.

text.p: Shares fell almost one and a half percent on Friday after the U.S. rally stalled overnight and investors pocketed some of the week's sharp gains here too, but brokers said sentiment continued buoyant.

The FOX index fell 1.4 percent to 1,203.68 points, while the all-share HEX was down 1.39 percent to 3,483.66 points. But the FOX ended up 3.6 percent on the week after four straight record high closes on Monday through Thursday.
Friday's 570 million markka volume was only moderate in comparison with earlier in the week. Nokia ended 8.00 markka lower at 438.00, down 1.8 percent.

The week's stellar gainer Raisio closed 17.00 markka lower at 623.00, above an intraday low of 601.00, and brokers said the stock seemed to be stabilising in the low 600s after shooting up 70 percent this week to Thursday.
Brokers said Nokia also came under pressure from profit-taking after rising this week by more than six percent to Thursday -- it still finished 4.5 percent higher for week.
Nokia did not escape jitters over U.S. technology stocks after the U.S. market gave a fickle reception to Microsoft's higher Q4 earnings, brokers said.
